name: CIC-IDS2017: Network Intrusion Detection Dataset
description: CIC-IDS2017 is a benchmark network intrusion detection dataset generated by the Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity. Captured over 5 days in July 2017, it includes benign background traffic and contemporary cyber attacks (Brute Force FTP, Brute Force SSH, DoS, Heartbleed, Web Attack, Infiltration, Botnet, and DDoS), provided as raw PCAPs and bidirectional flow records with 80+ network features.
